subject.title: Feature Request: Automated Session Memory Preservation & Synthesis

question: Should automatic reset/startup memory synthesis become an OpenClaw default/core memory path, a plugin/MCP capability published through ClawHub, or a narrower plugin API extension?
rationale: Current main exposes enough hooks and startup loading for external implementations, but choosing what OpenClaw should persist, synthesize, and re-inject by default affects session state, privacy, prompt security, provider use, and the special memory-plugin slot.

options.title: Keep Open For Core Memory Design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the product/security decision packet and require a bounded design before any implementation PR.

options.title: Route To ClawHub Plugin
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide reset synthesis is optional and current hooks/startup context are sufficient for a plugin, bundle, or MCP package.

options.title: Narrow To API Gap
options.body: Split out only the missing core hook or memory-plugin contract, then let external memory implementations own synthesis policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Core Memory Design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the product/security decision packet and require a bounded design before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent merged history in the session-memory persistence boundary and sanitizer path.
